scripts.dev: concurrently --names "frontend,mcp" --prefix-colors "blue,green" --kill-others-on-fail "bun run --cwd frontend dev" "bun run --cwd mcp_server dev"
scripts.start: concurrently --names "frontend,mcp" --prefix-colors "blue,green" --kill-others-on-fail "bun run --cwd frontend start" "bun run --cwd mcp_server start"
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:frontend && bun run typecheck:shared && bun run typecheck:mcp
scripts.prisma:migrate:dev: bun run --cwd packages/shared prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:migrate:deploy: bun run --cwd packages/shared prisma migrate deploy
scripts.prisma:migrate:status: bun run --cwd packages/shared prisma migrate status
